name: magicplan
description:
magicplan is a field app for measuring, documenting, and estimating on site, widely used in property restoration, insurance, and construction. This connector gives Claude read-only access to a magicplan workspace, so you can review and reason over project data directly in the conversation.

Once connected, Claude can:
- List and open projects, and read the field data captured on each floor plan
- Retrieve measured areas and volumes, broken down by floor and room
- Read the custom forms filled out on site, and the drying history recorded by moisture instruments
- Browse project photos and files, matched to the part of the building they document
- Open estimates down to individual line items and cost totals

A connection is authenticated at the workspace level with your magicplan Customer ID and API key, and acts on behalf of that whole workspace. The connector is read-only: it never creates, changes, or deletes anything in magicplan, and your API key is never shared with Claude.

Typical uses: preparing a scope of work from a restoration project, checking which rooms still need documentation, summarizing an estimate, or answering questions about a plan's measurements.

_published_faq.name: How do I add magicplan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add magicplan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cloud.magicplan.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the magicplan MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: magicplan provides these MCP tools: get_estimate, get_moisture_readings, get_plan_forms, get_plan_statistics, get_project, get_project_plan, get_project_snapshot, get_workspace, list_estimates, list_project_files, list_project_photos, and list_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to magicplan?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to magicplan in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
magicplan requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
magicplan is developed by magicplan. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
